item.title: COMME des GARÇONS' Youngest Designer Explains Dover Street Market's New Brand (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Kei Ninomiya, the youngest named COMME des GARÇONS designer, designed Dover Street Market's first in-house clothing line. In rare interview, he explains it.

item.title: Nike’s Freshest Running Shoe Looks Better in Its Natural Swooshless State
item.description: Nike reveals another "swooshless" Pegasus Premium running sneaker, this time dressed in a clean "Natural" colorway.

item.title: All Aboard the Nike ACG Relaunch
item.description: Nike announces ACG's relaunch with an Italian train called the ACG Express, featuring a cafe cart & the line's outdoor gear.

item.title: Nike's Techy Dad Shoe Makes Even Basic 'Fits Look Good
item.description: Nike's P-6000 "Off Noir" sneaker presents the classic dad shoe model in an equally timeless colorway.

item.title: Y-3 Knows Ball (& Insanely Luxurious adidas Hoops Sneakers)
item.description: adidas Y-3's Megaball sneaker is a luxurious remake of the brand's iconic Top Ten 2000 sneaker, realized in classic colorways.

item.title: Vans’ Super-Beefy Sneaker Enters a Dad Shoe Flow State
item.description: Vans' UltraRange Neo 2.0 sneaker is a chunky dad shoe gone Off the Wall. Here's everything on the model.

item.title: Converse's Ribbon-Tied Ballet Mary Jane Is Three Shoes in One
item.description: Converse's satin All Star LP BL OX ballet shoe is a three-part hybrid that plays the role of a sneaker, Mary Jane, & ballet slipper — all in one.
